publication.title: Marine diesel engine reliable intelligent fault diagnosis method based on the generalized multi-source information fusion
publication.reported_task: 11-state marine diesel thermal fault diagnosis; 24 thermal parameters
publication.reported_acquisition: real-vessel operating data collected every six seconds, with a calibrated one-dimensional simulation model
publication.reported_data_availability: Requests for diesel-engine thermal-parameter data are directed to the corresponding author; code is publicly deposited on GitHub.

reported_protocol.data_description_basis: GT-Power one-dimensional thermodynamic simulation representing eleven health states with approximately 233 samples per state
reported_protocol.article_methods_split: 70/30 random stratified train/test split and five-fold cross-validation
reported_protocol.comparability_note: These are paper-reported figures under the paper's own methods; they are not Symtropy measurements and are not independent-vessel transfer scores.

sample_csv.claim: The single CSV currently visible at the repository root is a one-class 1,025-row sample. It is not the eleven-state, 2,567-row data resource described in the paper and cannot reproduce the published multi-class result.

repository_script_split.distinction: The public script uses a shuffled 80/20 split, which differs from the article's described 70/30 split. Both are sample-level splits; neither establishes leave-run, leave-load, leave-vessel or voyage-level transfer.

transformations_and_selection.caveat: The script later uses a hard-coded feature-index list for the RF input. Do not assert that this exploratory MI calculation directly caused test leakage without reproducing the exact feature selection path; the entire selection process must be fitted inside training folds in a clean reproduction.
The noise generator is not seeded in the public script; this prevents exact pipeline replay. It is not by itself proof of train/test leakage.
This part of the public script is correctly fitted on the training split and applied to the test split.
The public script's optimizer objective uses three-fold CV, while the article describes five-fold validation in its Methods. The split and nested evaluation must be reconciled before reproduction.

reference_model_skeletons.mgcn_prediction: The public script labels the MGCN prediction path as a placeholder and generates random Dirichlet alpha values rather than performing out-of-sample graph inference.
reference_model_skeletons.dfcssaes_fusion: The public implementation calls the fusion a placeholder and averages probabilities rather than implementing the stated Dempster-Shafer procedure.
reference_model_skeletons.sdae_uncertainty: The public implementation uses random uncertainty and random conflict matrices as placeholders for Deng entropy and Belief Sinkhorn distance.
reference_model_skeletons.interpretation: These are source-level limitations of the public repository snapshot; they do not establish that the article's private research implementation used these placeholders.

audit_disposition.benchmark_action: Treat 99.45% as a literature reference only. Request the full data package, variable dictionary, sample/run provenance, original preprocessing, exact split manifest, and executable implementation from the corresponding author before reproducing.
required_reproduction_protocol: Obtain the complete 11-state dataset and license/access terms; bind bytes and provenance.
Reconcile paper split (70/30, five-fold) with the public script split (80/20, shuffled, three-fold tuning).
Recover original identifiers for voyage, engine, operating run, load and fault intervention; random row splits are not enough.
Run a within-source stratified reproduction only as a reference track.
Run leave-run and leave-load holdouts; freeze feature selection, scaling, tuning and calibration inside training partitions.
Test simulation-to-vessel and vessel-to-held-out-vessel separately; do not call simulation mixtures real-vessel generalization.
Report per-state macro recall, event recall, false alarms per observed hour, calibration, open-set false-known and cluster uncertainty.
Archive exact model, dataset, split, evaluator, code and dependency digests.
audit_disposition.claim_ceiling: Public-source preflight only: a one-class sample CSV and incomplete public model skeletons were inspected. The paper's complete data and private/reproducible implementation were not obtained. No paper score was reproduced or disproved.
